summary: Baseline was a repository containing only LICENSE: all nine dimensions absent. The foundation scaffold moved five dimensions to present and two to partial. The level remains Not ready because dimensions 6 (skills) and 9 (full runnability) cannot be satisfied until BotOS has application code. The remaining gaps are bounded by the repository being greenfield, not by the quality of the scaffold.

dimensions.name: Agent instructions
dimensions.notes: AGENTS.md covers architecture, key commands, conventions and guardrails. CLAUDE.md is a relative symlink to AGENTS.md rather than a second copy, so the two cannot drift.

dimensions.name: Decision records
dimensions.notes: Template, a written when/how guide, and a first real record for this change. Records are append-only; reversals supersede rather than delete.

dimensions.name: Codebase orientation
dimensions.notes: Directory map is complete for what exists. The module-edge section is deliberately empty because there is no application code, and carries an explicit TODO for the first module.

dimensions.name: Build / test / verify loop
dimensions.notes: make verify is real, enforced in CI, and negative-tested against eleven induced failures. No build step and no test suite exist; make test fails loudly rather than passing vacuously. Upgrades to present when a real runner lands and is registered in run_all().

dimensions.name: Setup / bootstrap contract
dimensions.notes: make bootstrap checks required tools and exits non-zero when one is missing, but installs nothing because the repository has no dependencies. Becomes a real contract once a stack is chosen.

dimensions.name: Skills
dimensions.notes: No .claude/skills/ or .claude/commands/. Skills encode workflows that really exist; authoring them for an undefined product would be invention. Flagged for a human.

dimensions.name: Guardrails & safety
dimensions.notes: Guardrails name what needs human approval, what must never be committed, and the MIT-license guardrail. The license guardrail is mechanically enforced: verify.sh fails if LICENSE is relicensed or its attribution altered.

dimensions.name: Secrets & env config
dimensions.notes: Names-and-placeholders contract is documented and enforced: the gate fails on a populated value in .env.example or a credential-shaped string in any tracked file. No env vars are referenced in code because there is no code.

dimensions.name: Full runnability (preconditions)
dimensions.notes: No application exists, so no full-app run command can exist and preconditions are not met. Needs live verification once product code lands. Not a scaffold defect.

flagged.reason: A skill must encode a workflow that really exists. Author .claude/skills/ once BotOS has a stack and a run loop.
bootstrap.sh installs nothing because there is nothing to install. Extend it when a toolchain is chosen.
Needs live verification; blocked on application code existing at all.
make test deliberately exits non-zero. Replace the stub with a real runner and register it in run_all() in scripts/verify.sh.
